harnessCorrections: Initial separate diagnostic APK could not attach because its signature did not match the installed app; it was removed. Existing signed instrumentation was reused with a private diagnostic JAR.

Initial playback attempts omitted the local proxy and multi-quality normalization, and some test Activities did not resume. Repeated with Server.start(), production Result URL selection and startActivitySync().
Bilibili requires jx=1 even when parse=0; final Bilibili result uses the configuration parser through ParseJob.
UiAutomation screenshots caused a test teardown exception in one run; final live continuity runs omit UiAutomation and record frame samples.
Intermediate test invocations rejected a diagnostic JAR checksum mismatch before executing any source. Those runs are excluded.
Initial live success criteria used endpoint position subtraction; final live assessments use sequential rendered-frame counters because HLS timeline windows slide.
